findings.summary: The official Andy's menu labels Cheese as dairy and wheat. Frozen Slice Cheese and Whole Cheese contain only milk, so their current allergen claims omit wheat.

The frozen baseline captured four entries that are not present in the customer-facing current Andy's Pizza menu: Buffalo Fried Cauliflower, Old Bay Fries, Wings Buffalo, and Wings Old Bay. The live Toast surface places similar legacy/duplicate content in a separate “Third Party - for Checkmate” operational category, indicating source-scope contamination.
Underberg Bitters is a beverage in Atlas Beverages & Merchandise, not an Andy's Pizza menu item; its frozen Pizza category is an extraction artifact.

The current customer-facing menu calls the item Whole Thru The Garden, while the frozen operational entry is Thu The Garden Pie (Vegan). The shared garden-vegetable composition supports a variant match, but the vegan wording is not published on the current customer-facing row.

summary: Identity is verified, but the frozen menu has four stale operational extras and one beverage artifact. Two Cheese items omit officially published wheat, so this restaurant requires discrepancy review rather than terminal verification.
